call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE original, standalone, flat Korean typographic poster for the assigned direction. This is one poster of a coordinated set; do not create a set, panels, a mockup or any extra image.
Original user request: 덕테이프 포스터로 '숨과 숨 사이'를 5장 만들어줘. 검은 글자와 흰 여백만 써줘. 문구는 한 번만 넣고, 그림·도형·테두리·구분선·질감·장식 기호·추가 문구는 넣지 마. 줄바꿈은 어절 사이에서만 해도 좋아.
For this single assigned poster: vertical 2:3 aspect ratio, fully opaque solid pure white canvas and black text only.
요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력

The complete visible text, exactly once and in this order, is: 숨과 숨 사이
Render these five Hangul syllables faithfully, with the three intact words 숨과 / 숨 / 사이. The two occurrences of 숨 belong to the supplied phrase; preserve both. No translation, no quotation marks, no duplicated title, no other visible writing.

Art direction: 연속된 한 줄 안에서 두 '숨' 사이의 실제 빈 폭을 제목의 주제로 만든다.
Design the phrase on ONE continuous horizontal baseline, with all five Hangul syllables the same visual height and weight. Keep the characters within each word naturally spaced. Make the word gap between 숨과 and 숨 visibly wider than the ordinary word gap between 숨 and 사이, so this one actual white interval embodies the pause between breaths. This intentional interval must not turn the words into disconnected corner labels. The phrase remains one readable line.
Use a precise, composed modern Korean sans-serif with medium weight, generous clear internal counters, crisp black strokes, no stretching or distortion of the glyphs. The text line should span roughly 72 percent of the poster width; the special inter-word pause should be about one Hangul character width. Set its shared baseline slightly above the vertical center, around 46 percent of the height. Balance the broad white margins as the active breathing space. Optical spacing and the measured pause provide the entire visual idea.

Mandatory conditions: black glyphs and pure white flat background only; the exact full phrase occurs once; no drawings, icons, shapes, border, divider, texture, decorative symbols, extra copy, watermarks, logos, shadows, gradients, embossing, paper grain or simulated photograph. Preserve each word and intact Hangul structures. Do not disassemble glyphs into decorative pictures. No line break for this direction. No clipping. The poster is a single finished image, with no surrounding presentation surface.

Second and final targeted EDIT of the supplied immediate-parent image: recreate the canvas as a clean digital typography graphic with perfectly flat, uniform #FFFFFF white everywhere except the five black glyphs. The current parent contains faint diagonal streaking in the empty areas, and gray duplicate/shadow contours just below the black letters. These are defects. Erase ALL that background and edge texture. The letters should be flat, uniform #000000 black with clean normal single anti-aliased contours; no gray offset copies, lower-edge shadows or halo. Do not depict a printed poster, photographed paper, textile, ink bleed or physical material. This is a direct PNG digital typography artwork on a plain white computer canvas. Preserve the visible phrase, intact Hangul structures, exact word order, single common baseline, one special wider gap after 숨과, same overall scale and balanced margins. No transparency. No other marks. Only the exact supplied phrase appears once. The 2:3 portrait canvas is entirely opaque.
